_comment: All gameplay constants must live here (or similarly named JSON files), never hardcoded in GDScript. See architecture.md and spec.md Constraints. Units: metres, seconds, m/s. MatchSim runs on the X (goal-to-goal length) / Z (touchline width) ground plane; Y is ball height.

kick._comment: Per-mechanic impulse + spin bands (task 1.3, game-design.md 2.3). speed/loft interpolate across the 0..1 power hold. axial_spin > 0 is topspin (ball dips), < 0 is backspin (ball floats); sidespin comes from the striker's approach angle, not from these.

first_touch._comment: How a player receives a moving ball (task 1.4, game-design.md 2.2 'first touch is the core mechanic'). Quality is a weighted blend of body orientation, closing speed and ball speed; it decides how much incoming speed survives the touch and how far a mis-control squirts sideways. Weights should sum to 1.0.
